GOVAN MBEKI LOCAL MUNICIPALITY (Secunda, Mpumalanga) - "TAX INVOICE/STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT".
Same eMunsoft ledger family as KwaDukuza / Abaqulusi / Alfred Duma / Bela-Bela / Emalahleni /
Ga-Segonyana / Phokwane / Modimolle-Mookgophong / Steve Tshwete: masthead + "TAX INVOICE/STATEMENT
OF ACCOUNT" heading, METER READINGS table, ACCOUNT DETAILS ledger, 009008 VAT line, 120+ DAYS
ageing row, REMITTANCE ADVICE / BANKING DETAILS footer, EasyPay barcode.

FINGERPRINT: "4000142424" (the municipality's VAT number) OR "GOVAN MBEKI MUNICIPALITY" (masthead)
OR "Govan Mbeki Municipality" (the BANKING DETAILS account name). Verified over the whole 221-PDF
Telkom tree: all three strings occur in exactly the 12 Govan Mbeki bills and nowhere else. Note the
VAT number is NOT written as the substring "VAT No.:4000142424" on the scans - OCR renders it
"VAT FAX: No.:4000142424" - so the fingerprint uses the bare 10-digit number.
DO NOT confuse with Emalahleni's VAT 4000142457: the first eight digits are identical, the
substring test is not.

TWO PHYSICAL SHAPES IN THE FOLDER
- 10 of 12 bills (~118 KB, 2 pages) have an intact text layer.
- 2 of 12 - GMM_MAR 2026.pdf and GMM_APR 2026.pdf (~675 KB) - are SCANNED IMAGES with no text
  layer at all (0 chars via page.get_text, 8 images/page). read_pdf(ocr="auto") returns ~2,185
  chars of Tesseract output; every row from them is force-flagged with exception code OCR.
  The scan resolution is fine - a 300 dpi render is perfectly legible to a human - but the bill's
  two data tables are drawn with full gridlines, and Tesseract reads the rules as characters and
  merges adjacent rows. On both scans the HEADER block and the REMITTANCE ADVICE footer come out
  essentially clean, while the METER READINGS and ACCOUNT DETAILS tables are destroyed
  ("sioaraozs sroar2026 Jotooat [020085 [ELECTRIGITY-OFF-PEAK [WATER ...").
  DELIBERATE DECISION: this profile extracts NO money and NO consumption from a scanned page.
  Every money/units pattern demands strict comma-grouped digits ending in exactly two decimals
  ("74,.126.50" and "8.678.00" - both real OCR output here - yield nothing), so the two scanned
  months come out with correct identity fields (account, site, statement date, invoice no, deposit,
  due date, TOTAL DUE - all hand-verified against the page images) and BLANK consumption/charges,
  with red required-misses in Diagnostics. See the report: one OCR'd figure happened to be right
  and its neighbour on the same line was wrong, so there is no honest way to tell them apart.

HEADER BLOCK (label:value pairs sharing lines, both shapes)
  Account Number: [number removed]      Account Date: 22 AUG 2025   -> billing_date, kept as printed
  Consumer Name: STREEKHOOFBESTUURDER(1TF)SEC AES             (Afrikaans for Regional Head Manager;
                                                               identifies the department, not the site)
  Tax Invoice No.: [number removed]   = account number + statement YYYYMM (-> gmm_invoice_period).
                                        NOTE this is the STATEMENT month, one month AFTER the
                                        consumption month the filename names.
  Vat Registration No.: (blank on every bill)   ERF Description: 01032 [number removed] 000000 0000
  Suburb: SECUNDA PROPER   Street: 1 VAN BELKUMSTRAAT   Market Value: 6,590,000.00
  Land Area: 2679.0000   Deposit: 0.00   Internet PIN: [number removed]   Postal Code: 46
  site_name = concat(Street, Suburb) = "1 VAN BELKUMSTRAAT SECUNDA PROPER". Consumer Name is kept
  separately as gmm_consumer_name.

METER READINGS TABLE - SHAPE A of this family: METER NO. / METER TYPE / OLD READING / NEW READING /
READING DATE / READING TYPE / CONSUMPTION. ONE reading date only -> canonical End Date; there is no
period start anywhere on the bill, so Start Date is "_none". (Shape B of the family - CONSUMPTION +
LEVIED AMOUNT + a "01/06/2026 - 01/07/2026" range - does NOT occur here; checked all 12 bills.)
  THE ROWS ARE IN RANDOM ORDER on every bill, so nothing may depend on row position.
  Five meters, five rows, on all 12 bills:
    [number removed]P  ELECTRICITY   -> the PEAK register     (suffix P)
    [number removed]S        ELECTRICITY   -> the STANDARD register (suffix S)
    [number removed]OP       ELECTRICITY   -> the OFF-PEAK register (suffix OP)
    9999 [D23]       KVA           -> maximum demand: OLD .000, NEW = the kVA level, CONSUMPTION = NEW
    3 [D124]         WATER         -> the water register (kL)
  Meter numbers contain letters and brackets, so the meter token is a generic
  "\S+(?:[ \t]+\[...\])?" rather than "\d{9,}". The suffix->band mapping is PROVEN on all 12
  bills (see identity 1) but is NOT used to fill the canonical band columns - those come from the
  ledger codes. It is captured into gmm_peak_meter_kwh / gmm_std_meter_kwh / gmm_offpeak_meter_kwh
  purely so the three-way cross-check can be run in a spreadsheet.
  Start/End Reading kWh are the SUM of the three electricity registers (CoJ convention); their
  difference equals Total kWh exactly on all 10 text bills.
  READING TYPE letters: electricity + KVA are "A" on 12/12 (-> "Actual" via TRANSLATE's exact-match
  path). WATER is "E" on 8 bills and "M" on 2 (NOV 2025, JAN 2026). "M" is NOT in TRANSLATE and is
  NOT guessed at - it is passed through as printed on the water row. Water reading type never
  touches the canonical electricity column.

ACCOUNT DETAILS LEDGER: DATE / CODE / DESCRIPTION / UNITS / TARIFF / VALUE. Every real levy prints
"@ <tariff>" between UNITS and VALUE; VAT-able levies carry a "*" flag just before VALUE. Credits
print a TRAILING minus ("245,356.34-"). Money is comma-grouped with a period decimal throughout -
no space thousands, no comma decimals.
  The CODE column is NOT always six digits - RATES is coded "00BUSS" - so code patterns use
  [0-9A-Z]{6} / explicit literals, never \d{6}.
  TARIFF PRECISION DRIFTS: bills up to JAN 2026 print 6 decimals (".022461", "123.520000"); from
  FEB 2026 they print 8 decimals with comma grouping ("0.[number removed]", "3,358.[number removed]"). Tariff
  patterns are therefore "[\d,]*\.\d+".

LEDGER CODES SEEN (complete, all 10 text bills + both scans read off the page images)
  00BUSS  RATES                                units = Market Value @ 0.022461  -> rates. NO "*" flag.
  020F01  ELECTRICITY NETWORK CHARGE           1.000 @ 123.52                   -> electricity, Other
  020053  ELECTRICITY - PEAK                   units = P register consumption    -> Peak kWh / Rands
  020054  ELECTRICITY - STANDARD               units = S register consumption    -> Standard kWh / Rands
  020055  ELECTRICITY - OFF-PEAK               units = OP register consumption   -> Off-Peak kWh / Rands
  020K54  ELECTRICITY KVA                      units = KVA register consumption  -> Demand kVA / Rands
  020054  ELECTRICITY - STANDARD BASIC CHARGE  1.000 @ 3,358.06                 -> electricity, Other
  010041  WATER                                units = water kL @ 38.16          -> water volumetric
  010B41  BASIC WATER   1.000 @ 135.63                                           -> water availability
  010B41  BASIC WATER   <kL> @ 1.23                                              -> water per-kL step
  010F01  FIXED CHARGE / STAND BASIC CHARGE    1.000 @ 23.98                     -> water (see below)
  070041  SEWERAGE                             units = water kL @ 13.41          -> sewerage volumetric
  070B41  BASIC SEWERAGE                       1.000 @ 57.01                     -> sewerage availability
  060044 / 060045  REFUSE                      3.000 @ 647.30 (060045 @ 798.58 on the MAY 2025 bill)
  008888  DIRECT DEPOSIT PAYMENT - THANK YOU   trailing minus                    -> payments
  009008  VAT                                                                    -> tax line
  RATES ARITHMETIC: 6,590,000.000 @ 0.022461 = 148,017.99, but the printed VALUE is 12,334.83 -
  EXACTLY one twelfth. The rates tariff is an ANNUAL rate levied monthly (UNITS x TARIFF / 12 ==
  VALUE on 10/10 text bills). Every other levy line satisfies UNITS x TARIFF == VALUE to the cent
  (130/130). Do not "fix" the rates column by multiplying valuation by tariff.
  ONE CODE, TWO MEANINGS: 020054 is BOTH "ELECTRICITY - STANDARD" (energy) and "ELECTRICITY -
  STANDARD BASIC CHARGE" (a flat monthly charge), and 010B41 is BOTH the R135.63 availability
  charge and the per-kL step. The discriminators are structural, not positional: for 020054 the
  description must be followed directly by the UNITS column (so "STANDARD BASIC CHARGE" cannot
  match the energy rule), and for 010B41 the availability line is the one whose tariff has two or
  more digits before the decimal point (135.63 vs 1.23). Both hold on 12/12.
  010F01 "FIXED CHARGE / STAND BASIC CHARGE" is classified as WATER purely on its 010 code prefix
  (020F01 is the electricity fixed charge, so F01 is "fixed charge" within each service family).
  The wording could equally be a property/stand charge. It is kept in its own field
  gmm_stand_basic_r so it can be moved to rates with a one-line canonical edit - flagged for Edwin.

PRIOR-PERIOD LINES - NONE EXIST in these 12 bills. Every levy line is dated the statement date and
carries "@ <tariff>"; there is no correction, rebate, reversal or adjustment line anywhere, so no
inclusion/exclusion decision was needed. Rather than assume that holds forever, each service has a
CATCH-ALL guard field that sums any ledger line with that service's code prefix and an unrecognised
description: gmm_other_elec_r (02x), gmm_water_other_r (01x), gmm_sewer_other_r (07x),
gmm_refuse_other_r (06x), gmm_rates_other_r (00BUSS). All five are 0/12 on this folder. A future
correction line lands in the guard field and in Other Charges instead of being silently dropped.

RULE ZERO - RECONCILE IS CIRCULAR HERE AND I AM SAYING SO. The bill prints no per-service subtotal
and no ex-VAT electricity total. total_ex_vat_r is the sum of the same five parts the Rand columns
hold, so the app's "peak+std+off+demand+other == total" check is structurally true and would also
"pass" with every column blank. The FOUR genuine checks, all against figures the extraction does
not construct:
  1. THREE-WAY kWh IDENTITY: for each band, ledger UNITS == meter CONSUMPTION == NEW - OLD.
     Exact (0.000) on all 10 text bills x 4 registers. This is the strongest check on the bill
     because it ties the Rand columns to two independently printed number columns.
  2. LINE ARITHMETIC: UNITS x TARIFF == VALUE, to the cent, on every levy line of all 10 text bills.
  3. VAT IDENTITY: printed 009008 VAT == 15% of gmm_vatable_r (the sum of every "*"-flagged line;
     RATES is excluded because it carries no "*"). Max deviation R0.03 over the folder - per-line
     rounding.
  4. ROLL-FORWARD: OPENING BALANCE + payments + RATES + every "*" line + printed VAT == printed
     CLOSING BALANCE. Closes to R0.00 on all 10 text bills. Exposed as gmm_rollforward_r so it can
     be compared with gmm_closing_balance in one spreadsheet column.
  5. FIVE-SERVICE SUM: electricity_ex + water_total + sewer_total + refuse_total + rates_total ==
     gmm_vatable_r + gmm_rates_ex_r (the ledger's own levy sum, built by two completely different
     document-scope rules). R0.00 on all 10 text bills. This is the check that caught a
     catch-all-guard regex bug the app's reconcile check happily reported as OK.
  6. TWO CROSS-MONTH CHAINS: each bill's CLOSING BALANCE == the next bill's OPENING BALANCE
     (11 of 11 links exact, including both scans via their extracted TOTAL DUE), and each bill's
     summed END reading == the next bill's summed START reading (9 of 9 links exact).

GUARD-FIELD REGEX TRAP (recorded so it is not reintroduced): the five catch-all guards must be
written "<code>[ 	](?![ 	]*(?:KNOWN|DESCRIPTIONS)[ 	])", NOT "<code>[ 	]+(?!KNOWN...)".
With [ 	]+ the engine backtracks to a single space and the negative lookahead then sees
" ELECTRICITY - PEAK" instead of "ELECTRICITY - PEAK", so it succeeds and the guard swallows every
known line. That put the whole electricity charge into gmm_other_elec_r (R178,411.41) and doubled
total_ex_vat_r - and the app's reconcile check still said OK, because other_r and total_ex_vat_r
are built from the same parts. Identity 5 is what exposed it.

AGEING ROW is 6 money columns (120+/90/60/30/CURRENT/CLOSING BALANCE). On this account the previous
balance is settled in full every month, so CURRENT == CLOSING BALANCE == TOTAL DUE on all 10 text
bills - but CURRENT is still a net BALANCE, not the current levy, so recon "current_ex" is left
unmapped (the bill prints no ex-VAT current-charges figure). recon "subtotal" reads the CLOSING
BALANCE column via a 5-groups-skipped pattern (extract_recon only ever takes capture group 1).

NOT PRINTED ANYWHERE (mapped "_none"): tariff name, period start date, NMD kVA, NMD Rands, cash,
guarantee, security held. Deposit is printed and is 0.00 on all 12 bills - a real zero, not a miss.

KNOWN APP LIMITATION (not fixable in a profile): _exc_date cannot parse "22 AUG 2025", the only
statement-date format this bill prints, so DUE<BILL / BILL-FUTURE / BILL-OLD can never fire on
Govan Mbeki rows. Adding "%d %b %Y" to _exc_date's format list would fix it for this whole family.

fields.label: Invoice period (YYYYMM in the invoice no)
RATES value (00BUSS, document scope - feeds the roll-forward)
Any other 02x electricity ledger line (guard)
fields.pattern: ^[ \t]*\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}[ \t]+02[0-9A-Z]{4}[ \t](?![ \t]*(?:ELECTRICITY - PEAK|ELECTRICITY - STANDARD|ELECTRICITY - OFF-PEAK|ELECTRICITY KVA|ELECTRICITY - STANDARD BASIC CHARGE|ELECTRICITY NETWORK CHARGE)[ \t])[^\n]*?[ \t]((?<![\d.,])-?\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.\d{2}-?)[ \t]*$
